description: R.A. Irangani Perera v. The Public Trustee and K.Nandani Perera R.A. Irangani Perera v. The Public Trustee and K.Nandani Perera View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: R.A. Irangani Perera v. The Public Trustee and K.Nandani Perera R.A. Irangani Perera v. The Public Trustee and K.Nandani Perera View More
keywords: Leave to Appeal application against District Court order in a testamentary action filed by the Public Trustee to recall letters of administration sent to Petitioner; Whether Petitioner had legal entitlement to administer the estate despite her husband predeceasing the deceased; Whether proper publication of order nisi was made. Held - Petitioner was appointed by consent of all parties; no evidence of mismanagement or abuse of administration. Application allowed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Civil Procedure Code
